title: SEC Declares Registration Statement Effective for Pasqal's Business Combination with Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II - Quantum Computing Report
gist: The SEC declared effective on August 5, 2026 the Form F-4 for French neutral-atom developer Pasqal's combination with SPAC Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II (NASDAQ: BBCQ), with a shareholder vote set for August 25 and a Nasdaq debut planned under ticker PSQL. Pasqal, founded in 2019 by Nobel laureate Alain Aspect and backed by over $300 million private funding, has fielded systems above 1,000 physical qubits and is targeting 10,000+ physical and 200 fault-tolerant logical qubits, with commercial anchors at CINECA, Los Alamos, Aramco and Crédit Agricole CIB.

insights.claim: The SEC declared Pasqal Holding SAS's joint Form F-4 registration statement with SPAC Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II (NASDAQ: BBCQ) effective on August 5, 2026, clearing the last regulatory hurdle before a shareholder vote.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Effectiveness moves the deal from regulatory risk to shareholder-approval and redemption risk — the remaining variables for the SPAC arb.
insights.locator: Opening paragraph — "French neutral-atom quantum computing developer Pasqal"

insights.claim: Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II has scheduled an extraordinary general meeting for August 25, 2026 to vote on the Pasqal transaction, after which the combined company will operate as Pasqal Holding SA and trade on Nasdaq under ticker PSQL.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A dated vote and reserved ticker put a near-term calendar catalyst on the board for anyone trading the quantum listing cohort.
insights.quote: Upon closing, the combined enterprise will operate as Pasqal Holding SA and trade on the Nasdaq stock exchange under the ticker symbol PSQL.

insights.claim: A French neutral-atom quantum developer is choosing a U.S. Nasdaq listing via SPAC rather than a European venue, following more than $300 million of private funding raised to date.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: European deep-tech continues to migrate to U.S. capital markets for liquidity — a persistent structural drain worth watching for policy response.
insights.locator: "With over $300 million in private funding raised to date"

insights.claim: Pasqal, founded in 2019 by Nobel laureate Alain Aspect and other quantum physicists, builds neutral-atom quantum processors that operate in standard data center environments rather than requiring specialized cryogenic facilities.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Standard data-center operation removes a major deployment cost barrier versus superconducting systems — the core commercial argument for neutral atoms.
insights.locator: "Founded in 2019 by Nobel laureate Alain Aspect"

insights.claim: Pasqal has deployed system architectures exceeding 1,000 physical qubits and is targeting a roadmap of over 10,000 physical qubits and 200 fault-tolerant logical qubits.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A 200 logical-qubit target is among the more aggressive published goals; the physical-to-logical ratio implied (10,000 to 200) is the number to interrogate.
insights.quote: the company has deployed system architectures exceeding 1,000 physical qubits while targeting a roadmap of over 10,000 physical qubits and 200 fault-tolerant logical qubits
insights.locator: "Founded in 2019 by Nobel laureate Alain Aspect"

themes.theme: HPC integration and quantum advantage claims

insights.claim: Pasqal launched Italy's first neutral-atom QPU at CINECA, integrating a 140-qubit system directly with the Leonardo supercomputer.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: HPC-center integrations are the realistic near-term sales channel for quantum hardware — recurring, government-funded, and reference-generating.

insights.claim: Pasqal collaborated with Los Alamos National Laboratory to demonstrate quantum advantage in materials simulation workloads.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A national-lab quantum advantage claim in materials simulation is the kind of validation that underwrites a listing narrative — verify the benchmark's classical baseline before crediting it.

insights.claim: Pasqal's commercial base spans South Korea's MegazoneCloud for deployment, Crédit Agricole CIB for capital market algorithm development, Saudi Aramco for industrial modeling, and True Nexus for 3D protein gelation modeling in sustainable food design.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Energy, banking, cloud and food-tech logos across three continents give the pre-listing story revenue breadth, though contract sizes are not disclosed.
